title.zh-TW: 終端機工作區支援多個側邊對話分頁，重啟後可重新開啟
title.en: Terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs and reopens saved chats after restart

body.zh-TW: 專案改到一半想順便問其他問題時，單一對話窗往往不夠用。⟦就像在螢幕旁釘上好幾張各自獨立的便條，以前只有一張紙容易互相蓋掉，現在可以各寫各的，重開程式也找得回本機留存的紀錄。⟧只要開啟這個需手動啟用的終端機工作區（支援多個側邊對話分頁的模式），就能同時開出多個側邊對話分頁。例如你正請 Codex 整理一份簡報大綱，順手想再問幾個語法問題，就能另開一個分頁處理。你可以隨時用鍵盤或滑鼠在分頁之間切換，就算把 Codex 關掉重開，先前儲存在本機的側邊對話也還能重新打開。
body.en: When you want to ask unrelated questions mid-project, a single chat pane is often not enough. ⟦Think of it like pinning several separate sticky notes beside your screen: previously one sheet easily got written over, whereas now each holds its own notes and local records stay retrievable after restarting.⟧ Once you turn on the opt-in terminal workspace (a mode supporting multiple side-chat tabs), you can open several side-chat tabs at once. For example, if you have Codex drafting a presentation outline and want to ask a few syntax questions on the side, you can open another tab for that. You can switch between tabs anytime with the keyboard or mouse, and even if you close and restart Codex, previously saved local side chats can still be reopened.

items.original: The opt-in terminal workspace supports multiple side-chat tabs. Switch between them with the keyboard or mouse, and reopen saved local side chats after restarting Codex. (#59784, #60152, #60181)

title.zh-TW: 代理指揮中心新增舊任務搜尋，可依名稱與目錄篩選
title.en: Agent command center adds search for older tasks by name and directory

body.zh-TW: 用過好幾輪 AI 任務後，想回頭找先前處理過的那一筆，往往得在一長串清單裡慢慢翻。現在在代理指揮中心（集中管理各項任務的控制畫面），可以直接搜尋過去的舊任務。你可以用任務名稱或提示詞預覽（當初下指令的開頭內容）來查。如果只記得當時放在哪個專案資料夾，也能直接輸入工作目錄（任務運作的資料夾路徑）搜尋。假設你上週請它幫忙整理會議紀錄，只要打進幾個當時寫的詞，就能立刻把那筆舊任務找出來。⟦好比在手機相簿翻找去年拍的旅遊照，以前得從最新一張一路往上滑，現在只要打地點、相簿名稱或畫面關鍵字就能直接跳到那一張。⟧
body.en: After running several rounds of AI tasks, finding a past item often meant scrolling through a long list. Now, in the agent command center (the control screen for managing tasks centrally), you can search older tasks directly. You can look them up by task name or prompt preview (the opening text of your original instruction). If you only remember which project folder a task lived in, you can also search by entering its working directory (the folder path where the task runs). Suppose you asked it to organize meeting notes last week: typing a few words you wrote then brings that older task right back up. ⟦Picture scrolling through your phone's photo album for a trip from last year: previously you had to swipe up from the newest shot, whereas now typing a place, album name, or visual keyword jumps straight to that photo.⟧

items.original: Search older tasks from the agent command center by name, prompt preview, or working directory. (#60286)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕紀錄可折疊回合細節，保留回覆並支援搜尋工具輸出
title.en: Full-screen transcript folds turn details while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable

body.zh-TW: 對話累積了不少來回步驟後，全螢幕對話紀錄（展開檢視完整往來過程的畫面）常被大量執行細節佔滿版面。⟦想像一份夾著大疊附錄的報告，以前得一頁頁越過查證過程才能看見正文，現在把附錄對折收起來只留結論，真要核對細節時也依然查得到。⟧只要在畫面裡打開 **Collapse turn details**，每次提問底下已經完成的活動就會摺疊收起。當你請它改完報告想順著讀一遍回覆時，AI 的答案依然會直接顯示在畫面上。就算細節收起來了，被折疊的工具輸出（外部工具回傳的執行結果）還是支援搜尋，隨時能翻出需要的片段。
body.en: After a conversation builds up many back-and-forth steps, the full-screen transcript (the expanded view showing the complete exchange) often fills up with execution details. ⟦Imagine a report clipped to a thick stack of appendices: previously you had to flip past pages of verification steps to reach the main text, whereas now folding the appendices away leaves the conclusions visible while still letting you look up details when needed.⟧ Turn on **Collapse turn details** in this view to fold completed activity beneath each prompt. When you want to read straight through the reply after it finishes revising a report, the AI's answers still stay visible on screen. Even with those details tucked away, folded tool output (execution results returned by external utilities) remains searchable so you can pull up any snippet anytime.

items.original: Turn on **Collapse turn details** in the full-screen transcript to fold completed activity beneath each prompt while keeping answers visible and tool output searchable. (#60554, #60555, #60556, #60557)

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援新增與編輯自訂模型供應商，可透過裝置代碼登入
title.en: Terminal supports adding and editing custom model providers with device-code sign-in

body.zh-TW: 如果你的團隊自架了 AI 服務，或是連到沒有圖形介面的遠端主機，要在終端機設定模型來源往往相當繞路。現在你可以直接在終端機新增或編輯自訂模型供應商（提供 AI 模型的服務窗口）。只要開啟自訂閘道器引導（協助首次連上自訂轉接閘道的設定流程），登入時就能順手建立供應商。當你透過 SSH（安全外殼協定，用來遠端操作主機的連線方式）連線，或是手邊沒有本機瀏覽器時，這個流程就很實用了。只要該閘道器支援，登入時便能改用裝置代碼（在別台裝置輸入即可驗證的短碼）完成授權。⟦跟在飯店電視登入串流帳號一樣，以前螢幕沒有瀏覽器就沒辦法當場開通，現在直接跳出一組配對碼，在手機輸入就能連好自訂來源。⟧
body.en: If your team self-hosts an AI service or connects to a remote machine without a graphical interface, configuring a model source in the terminal used to be roundabout. Now you can add or edit custom model providers (service endpoints that supply AI) directly from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding (the setup flow for connecting to your own relay for the first time) enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in. This flow is handy when connecting over SSH (a protocol for securely operating remote machines) or working without a local browser. When supported by that gateway, you can authorize sign-in using a device code (a short verification string you enter elsewhere) instead. ⟦Signing in works much like activating a streaming account on a hotel TV: without a browser on the screen you could not authorize on the spot before, whereas now a pairing code pops up for you to enter on your phone and link your custom source.⟧

items.original: Add or edit custom model providers from the terminal. With custom gateway onboarding enabled, you can create a provider during sign-in and use a device code for supported gateways over SSH or without a local browser. (#59779, #60009, #60186, #60486, #60662)

title.zh-TW: 終端機回報編輯器按 Ctrl+S 可本機儲存診斷壓縮檔
title.en: Pressing Ctrl+S in the terminal report editor saves a diagnostic ZIP locally

body.zh-TW: 碰到問題想整理錯誤資訊，偏偏上傳功能被關掉了，資料很容易卡在當下送不出去。現在只要在終端機回報編輯器（用來編輯與送出問題回報的介面）按下 `Ctrl+S`，就能把診斷用的 ZIP 壓縮檔直接存到本機。即使上傳功能處於停用狀態，這組快捷鍵依然可以正常存檔。當你在隔離網路環境下需要留下現場紀錄時，打開編輯器按下 `Ctrl+S`，就能把打包好的診斷檔案留在電腦裡。⟦試想寄件遇上投遞口封閉時，以前整疊資料只能卡在現場送不出去，現在隨時能先封進檔案袋自己收好。⟧
body.en: When you run into an issue and want to gather error details while uploads are turned off, that data can easily get stuck unsent. Now you can press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor (the interface for writing and submitting issue details) to save a diagnostic ZIP archive directly to your machine. Even when uploads are disabled, this shortcut still saves the file as expected. When you need to keep on-site records in an isolated network environment, opening the editor and pressing `Ctrl+S` keeps the packaged diagnostic archive right on your computer. ⟦When a mail drop slot is sealed shut, a stack of papers previously stayed stuck at the counter with nowhere to go, whereas now you can seal them into a folder and keep them yourself anytime.⟧

items.original: Press `Ctrl+S` in the terminal report editor to save a diagnostic ZIP locally, even when uploads are disabled. (#60542)

title.zh-TW: macOS 與 Linux 終端機雲端連線支援傳圖、選模型與封存對話
title.en: Cloud connection on macOS and Linux terminals supports sending images, choosing models, and archiving chats

body.zh-TW: 待在 macOS 或 Linux 終端機工作時，過去連上雲端對話後能調整的項目並不多。只要開啟需手動啟用的雲端連線（從本機終端機接上雲端服務的通道），現在在終端機裡就能直接操作更多項目。⟦彷彿把原本只通簡訊的遠端分機換成全功能桌面，現在圖片寄得過去、推理力道挑得動，談完的紀錄還能順手歸檔或救回來。⟧你可以直接在終端機傳送圖片，也能選擇要使用的模型與推理力度（決定 AI 推敲答案深度的檔位）。當你手邊有一張設計草圖想請雲端模型分析，或是想為複雜問題換個模型時，待在終端機就能一次完成。對話告一段落後，還能順手將雲端對話封存，日後有需要也能再還原回來。
body.en: When working in a macOS or Linux terminal, there used to be few options you could adjust once connected to a Cloud conversation. With the opt-in Cloud connection (a bridge from your local terminal to hosted services) enabled, you can now handle much more right inside the terminal. ⟦An old remote extension that only sent text messages has turned into a full-featured desk: now images go through, thinking depth is selectable, and finished conversations can be filed away or brought back.⟧ You can send images directly from the terminal, and choose both the model and the reasoning effort (the setting that controls how deeply the AI thinks through answers). Whether you have a design sketch for a Cloud model to inspect or want to switch models for a complex question, you can do it all without leaving the terminal. Once a conversation wraps up, you can archive that Cloud chat and restore it later if needed.

items.original: With the opt-in Cloud connection on macOS and Linux, send images, choose a model and reasoning effort, and archive or restore Cloud conversations from the terminal. (#59828, #60061, #60635, #60651)

title.zh-TW: codex exec 在未受信任目錄停用專案設定，可加 --trust 儲存信任
title.en: codex exec keeps project config disabled in untrusted directories unless saved with --trust

body.zh-TW:
剛接手一個來路不明的專案資料夾時，直接跑自動化任務難免擔心裡頭的設定被擅自啟用。在未受信任的目錄中，`codex exec` 現在會持續停用專案設定與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。就算你同時加上了 `--sandbox workspace-write`（允許在工作區寫入檔案的沙盒權限），這兩項還是不會啟用。若確認該資料夾可以放心，可用 `codex exec` 或 `codex review` 搭配 `--trust` 明確儲存專案信任：

```bash
codex exec --trust
codex review --trust
```

⟦如同陌生訪客來家裡幫忙搬東西，就算你准許他進客廳動手，在屋主正式授權前，屋裡的電器開關依舊全部上鎖。⟧
body.en:
When taking over an unfamiliar project folder, running automated tasks right away raises the concern of its settings being activated without your say. In untrusted directories, `codex exec` continues to keep project configuration and MCP (a protocol that lets AI link to external tools) servers disabled. Even if you also pass `--sandbox workspace-write` (a permission level that allows writing files in the project folder), neither will be enabled. Once you confirm the folder is safe, use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust:

```bash
codex exec --trust
codex review --trust
```

⟦A stranger coming over to help move furniture might be allowed into your living room to work, yet every appliance switch stays locked until the homeowner explicitly grants permission.⟧

items.original: `codex exec` keeps project configuration and MCP servers disabled in untrusted directories, even with `--sandbox workspace-write`. Use `--trust` with `codex exec` or `codex review` to explicitly save project trust. (#60041)

title.zh-TW: 清空脈絡並實作會完整交接核准計畫，失敗時保留原工作階段
title.en: Yes, clear context and implement hands off the full approved plan and keeps the original session on failure

body.zh-TW: 討論並核准一份執行計畫後，點選 **Yes, clear context and implement**，就能清空前面冗長的脈絡並直接動工。這個選項現在會把整份核准計畫，完整交接給新開啟的工作階段（單次獨立的對話與執行環境）。萬一交接中途失敗，原本的工作階段也會維持開啟狀態。當你花了不少心思對齊步驟、準備放手讓 Codex 執行時，就能放心按下清空，不怕進到新對話後計畫缺漏，或是交接出錯就兩頭落空。⟦宛如醫院輪班時把整本核定的醫囑交給下一班，要是對方沒順利接手，原本這一班就會繼續留在崗位上不撤離。⟧
body.en: After discussing and approving an execution plan, selecting **Yes, clear context and implement** clears the lengthy prior context and starts work right away. This option now hands the full approved plan over to the fresh session (a single standalone conversation and execution environment). If the handoff fails partway through, the original session stays open. Once you have spent time aligning the steps and are ready to let Codex run, you can clear context with confidence without worrying about missing parts of the plan in the new chat or losing both sides if the handoff errors out. ⟦At a hospital shift change, handing the entire approved chart to the next shift means the outgoing team stays at its post rather than walking away if the handoff falls through.⟧

items.original: **Yes, clear context and implement** now hands the full approved plan to the fresh session and keeps the current session open if the handoff fails. (#60763)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 沙盒處理引號 cmd.exe 路徑與 PowerShell 權限問題
title.en: Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted cmd.exe paths and PowerShell permissions

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）時，以前只要 `cmd.exe` 的路徑帶有引號，或是 PowerShell 工作階段的工作目錄上層資料夾無法讀取，執行就會出錯。這兩個情境下的 Windows 沙盒處理問題現在已經修好。
body.en: When using the sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts what programs can access) on Windows, execution used to fail whenever a `cmd.exe` path was quoted or a PowerShell session's working directory had an unreadable parent folder. Windows sandbox handling for both scenarios has now been fixed.

items.original: Fixed Windows sandbox handling for quoted `cmd.exe` paths and for PowerShell sessions whose working directory has an unreadable parent. (#60624, #60647)

title.zh-TW: macOS 貼上圖片保留正確方向，可取用原生 PNG 與 JPEG 資料
title.en: Pasted images on macOS keep their orientation and use native PNG or JPEG data

body.zh-TW: 從 macOS 複製圖片直接貼進對話想請 AI 判讀時，方向歪掉一直很讓人困擾。現在在 macOS 貼上圖片，會確實保留圖片原本預期的方向。只要剪貼簿（暫存複製內容的系統空間）裡本身帶有原生的 PNG 或 JPEG 資料，就會使用這些原生格式。當你從修圖工具或相簿複製好一張直式畫面貼上時，不用再擔心貼進來變成橫躺的。⟦打個比方，拿剛調正角度的相片傳給朋友，以前送過去偶爾會翻倒，現在方向會維持原樣。⟧
body.en: Copying an image on macOS and pasting it into a chat for the AI to inspect used to be frustrating when its orientation came out sideways. Pasted images on macOS now reliably retain their intended orientation. Whenever native PNG or JPEG data is present on the clipboard (the system space that temporarily holds copied items), those native formats are used. When you copy a portrait shot from an image editor or photo album and paste it in, you no longer have to worry about it landing on its side. ⟦Sending a freshly straightened photo to a friend used to flip sideways on arrival sometimes, whereas now it keeps its upright orientation.⟧

items.original: Pasted images on macOS retain their intended orientation and use native PNG or JPEG clipboard data when available. (#60455)

title.zh-TW: 終端機不再苦等未回報的 MCP 伺服器，中斷回合收尾更乾淨
title.en: Terminal no longer waits on unreported MCP servers, and interrupted turns close cleanly

body.zh-TW:
操作到一半按下停止或等候外部連線時，偶爾會遇上終端機持續忙碌、甚至誤傷下一輪對話的狀況。⟦猶如舞台剛落幕就該把上一場收乾淨，以前沒報到的名單或晚到的喊卡聲會拖累下一幕，現在這場一停就乾脆收尾，不再牽連下一場。⟧

終端機不再一直忙著等待共用應用程式伺服器未回報的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。共用應用程式伺服器是在背景協調連線的程式。

至於被中斷的對話回合，現在結束得更乾淨。先前延遲抵達的中止指令或檔案核准取消操作，也不會再誤打斷後面的新回合。
body.en:
When you hit stop mid-task or wait on external connections, the terminal can occasionally stay busy or even disrupt the next conversation turn. ⟦Once the curtain falls, the stage crew clears the previous act right away; previously, missing roll calls or late cue-to-stop shouts dragged down the next scene, but now ending one act wraps it up cleanly without spilling into the next.⟧

The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP (the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers that a shared app server did not report. A shared app server is a program that coordinates connections in the background.

Interrupted conversation turns now close more cleanly. Delayed aborts or file approval cancellations also no longer mistakenly interrupt a later turn.

items.original:
The terminal no longer stays busy waiting for MCP servers that a shared app server did not report. (#60280, #60622)
Interrupted turns now close cleanly, and delayed aborts or file approval cancellations no longer interrupt a later turn. (#59910, #60700)

title.zh-TW: 更新 openai-docs 技能與文件，補齊團隊設定與閘道器授權說明
title.en: Updated `openai-docs` skill and documentation with team setup and gateway authorization

body.zh-TW:
剛開始導入工具或替整個團隊統一設定時，官方說明若不夠聚焦，常讓人不知道該從哪份指引看起。⟦好似重新編寫公司的新人報到包，個人剛進門要辦哪些手續、整個部門怎麼統一規矩，連合作窗口怎麼查表都一次寫明白。⟧

`openai-docs` 技能（預先寫好給 AI 查閱的專業知識模組）已經更新，內容改為聚焦在 Codex 與 ChatGPT Work 的相關問題，以及第一次使用 API 的設定步驟，並加入專章說明如何在整個團隊裡統一設定 Codex。

官方也補上了給應用程式伺服器客戶端（連上背景服務進行操作的外部程式）參考的文件，說明如何在不更動預設供應商的前提下，列出已設定供應商的模型或為閘道器授權。
body.en:
When first adopting a tool or standardizing settings for an entire team, unfocused official documentation can leave you unsure where to start. ⟦Rewriting a company onboarding packet makes everything clear at once: what steps a newcomer takes on arrival, how the whole department aligns its rules, and even how partner contacts look up the directory.⟧

Official documentation has also been added for app-server clients (external programs that connect to a background service to operate), explaining how to list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider.

Updated the `openai-docs` skill to focus on Codex and ChatGPT Work questions and first-time API setup, with dedicated guidance for configuring Codex across a team. (#59944, #59949)
Documented how app-server clients can list models or authorize a gateway for a configured provider without changing the default provider. (#59776, #59819)

title.zh-TW: 內建 SQLite 升級至 3.54 版，納入預寫日誌修復
title.en: Bundled SQLite upgraded to 3.54 with write-ahead log fixes

body.zh-TW: 查看 Codex 這次更新的隨附元件時，你會看到資料庫引擎的版本也有變動。Codex 這次將隨附的 SQLite（輕量級的本機檔案型資料庫）升級到 3.54 版。這次版本更新主要是為了納入預寫日誌（把資料變更先記進日誌檔再寫回主檔的機制）相關的修復項目。⟦正像會計師換用新版流水帳本，把先記草稿再謄進總帳這道工序裡的毛病修好，日常在背後默默把紀錄抄穩。⟧
body.en: When checking the bundled components in this Codex update, you will notice a version bump for the database engine. Codex upgrades its bundled SQLite (a lightweight local file-based database) to version 3.54. This update mainly picks up fixes related to the write-ahead log (a mechanism that records data changes to a journal file before writing them back to the main file). ⟦Just as an accountant switches to a newer ledger, the flaws in jotting down a draft before posting it to the general ledger are fixed, keeping everyday records steady behind the scenes.⟧

items.original: Updated bundled SQLite to 3.54 to pick up write-ahead log fixes. (#60432)

title.zh-TW: 外掛市集升級可沿用本機 Git 物件，減少重複下載
title.en: Plugin marketplace upgrades reuse local Git objects to reduce repeat downloads

body.zh-TW: 當你準備替擴充商店更新到最新版時，若每次都得把整包資料從頭抓過一次，總會多傳許多電腦裡早就有過的內容。現在外掛市集（用來瀏覽與安裝擴充功能的商店）升級時，可以沿用電腦裡的既有資料。升級過程中會直接重複使用已經存在硬碟上的 Git 物件（版本控制系統用來保存檔案與歷程紀錄的資料單位），藉此減少重複下載的資料量。當你升級外掛市集時，不必再把已經下載過的內容通通重抓一遍。⟦譬如更換新版百科全書時，以前得整套厚書重寄一箱，現在發現書架上原本就有前幾冊，只要把新頁面補齊就好。⟧
body.en: When updating an extension store to the latest version, fetching the entire bundle from scratch every time transfers a lot of content your computer already has. Now, when the plugin marketplace (the store used to browse and install extensions) upgrades, it can reuse existing data on your computer. During the upgrade, it directly reuses Git objects (the data units a version control system uses to store files and history) already on disk, reducing the amount of data downloaded again. When you upgrade the plugin marketplace, you no longer have to re-download everything you have already fetched. ⟦Replacing an encyclopedia with a newer edition used to mean shipping a whole box of heavy volumes again, whereas now, seeing the earlier volumes already on the shelf, only the new pages need to be filled in.⟧

items.original: Plugin marketplace upgrades can reuse Git objects already on disk, reducing repeat downloads. (#60528)

first_title.zh-TW: 挑好新對話的模型供應商，舊對話依然照原設定跑
first_title.en: Pick a Model Provider for New Chats While Existing Ones Keep Theirs

entries: Added the `run_workflow` tool for everyone: the agent can run a Python workflow script that fans work out to many subagents in parallel or in stages and then combines their results. It uses the Python bundled with the CLI, so you don't need Python installed.

Added a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings, so organizations that don't use Gemini Enterprise can control plugins too: `pluginsDisabled` stops all plugins from loading, including built-in ones, and blocks installing or enabling them, while `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace but keeps installed plugins working. Gemini Enterprise users keep following their organization's Cloud Console policy.

Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, so it decides faster and times out less often: the reviewer can now search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly instead of starting a sandboxed command for each check.

Improved `/resume`: the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on "Loading conversations..." in long sessions, and `/resume <id>` now accepts any prefix that matches exactly one conversation, such as the short ID shown in the status line, and reports `conversation <id> not found` for an unknown ID instead of silently opening the picker.
Improved `/browser` subagent session recordings, which are now `.mp4` files made with Chrome's built-in screen recording instead of `.webm`.

Fixed a security issue where custom headers configured for an HTTP MCP server, such as API keys, could be forwarded to a different host when the server responded with a redirect; they are now sent only to the configured server's own origin.

Fixed the terminal UI accepting malformed or implausible window-size reports, such as negative or extremely large dimensions from stray escape sequences, which could make the CLI freeze or use excessive memory; these reports are now ignored.

Fixed several `agy acp` issues: a session no longer fails with "Authentication required" after `agy acp --login` when `settings.json` names an auth method that has no credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), because the CLI now falls back to your saved login; prompts no longer fail when the ACP client passes an MCP server whose name contains spaces or other special characters; a failed turn now reports its specific error, such as a model or quota error, instead of "Agent execution terminated due to error."; and the diffs sent for completed edits no longer carry an extra trailing newline in `oldText` and `newText`.

Fixed more cases of files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) being mishandled: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is now honored on the first run, `agy acp` now loads your settings and authentication options instead of falling back to defaults, and `agy plugin validate` now runs all of its checks on such a `hooks.json` and reports the real syntax error and line instead of blaming the BOM.

Fixed `-i`/`--prompt-interactive` together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue`: the prompt is now sent to the resumed conversation after its history loads, instead of starting a new conversation, and it is handled like typed input, so it shows right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports a failed send.

Fixed `!` shell commands on Windows: PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed, and quitting the CLI or killing the task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs the command started instead of leaving them running and the task marked as running.
Fixed `/copy` and other clipboard actions on Windows over SSH: the copy now reaches your local clipboard, and the copied text is no longer written to the CLI log file.
Fixed scheduled automations on Windows receiving only the first line of a multi-line prompt; each scheduled or manually triggered run now gets the full prompt.

Fixed the macOS "Keychain Not Found" dialog reappearing about once an hour: after a keychain write fails, the CLI now saves your sign-in token to its file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.
Fixed a race where reloading MCP servers while several subagents were starting could launch duplicate MCP server processes, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins.

Fixed MCP server and plugin OAuth sign-in on machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` when `127.0.0.1` is unavailable instead of failing silently.
Fixed signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` sometimes reporting that the sign-in didn't finish when it had just succeeded.

Fixed tool groups jumping around when expanded with `Ctrl+O`: the collapse hint now stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low verbosity the token summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.
Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view on phones, where the list could not be scrolled by touch past the first screen, so models near the end of the list could not be selected.

title.zh-TW: 開放 run_workflow 工具，讓子代理分工跑 Python 流程
title.en: The run_workflow tool is now available for subagents to run Python workflows

body.zh-TW: 當你手上有整批問卷或報告要整理，單靠單一視窗逐份處理太慢時，現在所有人都能使用 `run_workflow` 工具。⟦想像以前大廚得一個人從洗菜做到擺盤，現在直接把切菜、熬湯、擺盤分派給多位助手平行或分階段處理，最後由他匯總上菜，連廚具都自帶齊全。⟧你在跟代理整理大量資料或拆解多步驟任務時，只要請它啟用 `run_workflow`，代理就能執行 Python 工作流程腳本（一串照步驟跑的自動化程式）。這份腳本會把工作平行派發或分階段交給多個子代理執行，最後再把結果彙整起來。即使你的電腦沒有另外安裝 Python，它也能直接使用 CLI（指令列工具）隨附的 Python 來跑。
body.en: When you have a whole batch of surveys or reports to organize and handling them one by one in a single window is too slow, everyone can now use the `run_workflow` tool. ⟦Imagine a head chef who used to handle everything from washing vegetables to plating alone, but now delegates chopping, simmering soup, and plating to multiple assistants in parallel or in stages before combining the dishes to serve, with all the kitchenware already included.⟧ When you are organizing large amounts of data or breaking down multi-step tasks with the agent, just ask it to enable `run_workflow`, and it can run a Python workflow script (an automated program that follows a sequence of steps). This script fans work out to multiple subagents in parallel or in stages, then combines their results. Even if Python is not separately installed on your computer, it can run directly using the Python bundled with the CLI (command-line tool).

items.original: Added the `run_workflow` tool for everyone: the agent can run a Python workflow script that fans work out to many subagents in parallel or in stages and then combines their results. It uses the Python bundled with the CLI, so you don't need Python installed.

title.zh-TW: 管理員設定新增 pluginControls，非企業方案也能控管外掛
title.en: Admin settings add pluginControls so non-enterprise teams can manage plugins

body.zh-TW: 沒有導入 Gemini Enterprise 的團隊，過去很難統一控管成員電腦裡的外掛。⟦好比學校圖書室依規定調整借閱，完全停用時連館內現有書架都封起來不准翻閱，若只關閉新書採購櫃位，大家手邊已借出的書仍能繼續使用。⟧管理員現在可以在受控管的管理員設定裡加入 `pluginControls` 區段，按需求選擇兩種控制開關：`pluginsDisabled` 用來停用所有外掛（包含內建外掛），並禁止安裝或啟用任何外掛。`marketplaceDisabled` 則只會關閉外掛市集，已經安裝好的外掛仍可照常運作。若是 Gemini Enterprise 使用者，依舊會遵循所屬組織在 Cloud Console（Google 雲端管理主控台）設定的政策。
body.en: Teams that have not adopted Gemini Enterprise previously had a hard time centrally controlling plugins on members' computers. ⟦Think of a school library adjusting its lending rules: a full shutdown seals off even the existing shelves so nothing can be browsed, whereas closing only the new-book acquisition desk lets everyone keep using the books they have already borrowed.⟧ Admins can now add a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings and choose between two control switches as needed: `pluginsDisabled` disables all plugins (including built-in ones) and blocks installing or enabling any plugin. Meanwhile, `marketplaceDisabled` only turns off the plugin marketplace, so already installed plugins continue working as usual. Gemini Enterprise users still follow their organization's policy set in Cloud Console (Google's web-based admin hub).

items.original: Added a `pluginControls` section to managed admin settings, so organizations that don't use Gemini Enterprise can control plugins too: `pluginsDisabled` stops all plugins from loading, including built-in ones, and blocks installing or enabling them, while `marketplaceDisabled` turns off the plugin marketplace but keeps installed plugins working. Gemini Enterprise users keep following their organization's Cloud Console policy.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式改採直接翻查加快沙盒外指令審查
title.en: Auto mode switches to direct lookups to speed up out-of-sandbox command reviews

body.zh-TW: 開著自動模式讓 AI 幫忙跑指令時，只要指令準備跨出終端機沙盒（隔離執行的安全環境），審查步驟就常讓人等得心急甚至逾時。⟦猶如編輯審查稿件時，以前每確認一個細節都要發公文去外單位查證，常常等到逾期；現在手邊就有通訊錄和檔案夾能直接翻找，立刻就能決定放行或擋下。⟧以前審查員每做一項檢查，都得另外啟動一個沙盒內的指令來跑。現在審查員可以直接搜尋對話內容、列出資料夾清單並搜尋檔案，因此能更快做出判斷，也較少發生逾時。
body.en: When Auto mode is on and the AI runs commands for you, the review step often made you wait anxiously or even timed out whenever a command was about to leave the terminal sandbox (an isolated security environment for execution). ⟦An editor reviewing a manuscript used to send an official memo to an outside office for every detail they needed to verify, often missing deadlines; now they have the directory and folders right at hand to flip through and decide immediately whether to approve or block it.⟧ Previously, the reviewer had to launch a separate sandboxed command for each check. Now the reviewer can search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly, allowing it to decide faster and time out less often.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox, so it decides faster and times out less often: the reviewer can now search the conversation, list directories, and search files directly instead of starting a sandboxed command for each check.

title.zh-TW: 改善 /resume 載入效能並支援短 ID 與查無提示
title.en: Improve /resume loading performance and add short ID and not-found support

body.zh-TW: 想接續昨天的長對話繼續工作，輸入 `/resume` 卻只看到畫面一直卡在「Loading conversations...」嗎？⟦就像到大型行李寄物區領包裹一樣，以前店員要把每個櫃子都打開清點一遍才讓你挑，人一多就卡在門口；現在只對櫃號前幾碼就能精準取出，遇到空號也會直接告訴你。⟧現在開啟對話選擇器時，不再抓取每個開啟中對話的完整歷史紀錄，因此在較長的工作階段裡不會再卡在載入畫面。用 `/resume <id>` 指定對話時，只要輸入的開頭字元能唯一對應到一個對話（例如狀態列顯示的短 ID）就能直接恢復。如果輸入了不存在的 ID，畫面會明確回報 `conversation <id> not found`，不再靜悄悄地直接打開選擇清單。
body.en: Want to pick up yesterday's long conversation where you left off, only to type `/resume` and see the screen stuck on "Loading conversations..."? ⟦At a large luggage check counter, attendants previously had to open and inventory every locker before letting you pick, causing a bottleneck at the door; now matching just the first few digits of a locker number pulls out the exact item, and an empty number is reported to you right away.⟧ Opening the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on the loading screen in longer sessions. When specifying a conversation with `/resume <id>`, any prefix that uniquely matches one conversation (such as the short ID shown in the status line) resumes it directly. If you enter an ID that does not exist, it clearly reports `conversation <id> not found` instead of silently opening the picker.

items.original: Improved `/resume`: the conversation picker no longer fetches the full history of every open conversation, so it no longer stalls on "Loading conversations..." in long sessions, and `/resume <id>` now accepts any prefix that matches exactly one conversation, such as the short ID shown in the status line, and reports `conversation <id> not found` for an unknown ID instead of silently opening the picker.

title.zh-TW: 瀏覽器子代理錄影改用 Chrome 內建錄製並存成 .mp4
title.en: Browser subagent recordings now use Chrome built-in capture and save as .mp4

body.zh-TW: 請 `/browser` 子代理代為操作網頁時，它錄下的工作階段影像現在有了新變化。以前這類瀏覽器操作錄影會存成 `.webm` 檔，現在則改由 Chrome 內建的螢幕錄影功能進行錄製，直接產出 `.mp4` 檔案。⟦彷彿活動側錄換成場地內建的錄影機，交片的格式也跟著換了；原本用一種規格收片，現在改收另一種。⟧下次你打開 `/browser` 子代理的工作階段錄影回顧操作過程時，拿到的就會是 `.mp4` 檔案。
body.en: When you ask the `/browser` subagent to operate web pages for you, its session video recordings have a new update. Previously these browser operation recordings were saved as `.webm` files, whereas now they are recorded using Chrome's built-in screen recording feature to output `.mp4` files directly. ⟦Switching an event shoot to the venue's built-in recorder changes the delivery format too; where footage used to arrive in one specification, it now comes in another.⟧ Next time you open a `/browser` subagent session recording to review the steps taken, you will get an `.mp4` file.

items.original: Improved `/browser` subagent session recordings, which are now `.mp4` files made with Chrome's built-in screen recording instead of `.webm`.

title.zh-TW: 修復 HTTP MCP 重新導向時誤傳自訂標頭的安全性問題
title.en: Fix security issue where HTTP MCP redirects forwarded custom headers

body.zh-TW: 替遠端 HTTP MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器設定自訂標頭後，只要對方回傳重新導向就可能出狀況。像 API 金鑰這類自訂標頭先前可能會被轉送給其他主機，現在這項安全性問題已經修好，只會送給原本設定的伺服器來源。
body.en: After configuring custom headers for a remote HTTP MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server, returning a redirect could cause trouble. Custom headers like API keys could previously be forwarded to a different host, and this security issue is now fixed so they are sent only to the originally configured server origin.

items.original: Fixed a security issue where custom headers configured for an HTTP MCP server, such as API keys, could be forwarded to a different host when the server responded with a redirect; they are now sent only to the configured server's own origin.

title.zh-TW: 忽略異常的終端機視窗尺寸回報避免畫面凍結
title.en: Ignore abnormal terminal window-size reports to prevent UI freezes

body.zh-TW: 操作 CLI（指令列工具）時，程式有時會突然凍結或佔用過多記憶體。這是因為誤傳的逸出字元序列（控制游標或畫面的特殊字元組合）送出了負數或極端龐大的視窗尺寸回報，過去終端機介面會照單全收，現在這些無效回報會被直接忽略。
body.en: When using the CLI (command-line tool), the program could sometimes freeze suddenly or consume excessive memory. This happened because stray escape sequences (special character combinations that control the cursor or screen) sent negative or extremely large window-size reports that the terminal UI previously accepted as-is, and these invalid reports are now ignored.

items.original: Fixed the terminal UI accepting malformed or implausible window-size reports, such as negative or extremely large dimensions from stray escape sequences, which could make the CLI freeze or use excessive memory; these reports are now ignored.

title.zh-TW: 修復 agy acp 登入備援、特殊字元名稱與錯誤回報問題
title.en: Fix agy acp login fallback, special-character names, and error reporting

body.zh-TW:
使用 `agy acp` 時，過去容易撞上的四個問題現在已經修復。

執行 `agy acp --login` 後，就算 `settings.json` 指定了缺少憑證的驗證方式（例如設成 `gemini-api-key` 卻沒給 `GEMINI_API_KEY`），工作階段也不會再跳出「Authentication required」失敗，CLI 會改用已儲存的登入資料作為備援。

當 ACP 用戶端傳入名稱含空白或其他特殊字元的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，送出提示詞不再因此失敗。回合失敗時，現在會回報模型或額度這類具體錯誤，不再只顯示「Agent execution terminated due to error.」。編輯完成後送出的差異比對中，`oldText` 與 `newText` 結尾也不再多出一個多餘的換行符號。
body.en:
Four issues you could easily run into when using `agy acp` have now been fixed.

After running `agy acp --login`, even if `settings.json` specifies an authentication method without a credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), the session no longer fails with "Authentication required", and the CLI falls back to your saved login.

When the ACP client passes an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) server whose name contains spaces or other special characters, sending prompts no longer fails because of it. When a turn fails, it now reports specific errors such as a model or quota error instead of only showing "Agent execution terminated due to error.". In the diffs sent after edits complete, `oldText` and `newText` also no longer carry an extra trailing newline.

items.original: Fixed several `agy acp` issues: a session no longer fails with "Authentication required" after `agy acp --login` when `settings.json` names an auth method that has no credential (such as `gemini-api-key` without `GEMINI_API_KEY`), because the CLI now falls back to your saved login; prompts no longer fail when the ACP client passes an MCP server whose name contains spaces or other special characters; a failed turn now reports its specific error, such as a model or quota error, instead of "Agent execution terminated due to error."; and the diffs sent for completed edits no longer carry an extra trailing newline in `oldText` and `newText`.

title.zh-TW: 修妥 UTF-8 BOM 檔頭導致設定與外掛驗證誤判的問題
title.en: Fix UTF-8 BOM headers causing settings and plugin validation misreads

body.zh-TW: 檔案若在儲存時帶有 UTF-8 BOM（用來標記編碼的隱藏開頭標記），過去常會被錯誤處理。現在包含這三種情況都已修復：首次執行時會正確套用 `settings.json` 裡的 `"modelProvider"` 設定；`agy acp` 也會正常載入你的設定與驗證選項，不再退回使用預設值作為備援。對這類 `hooks.json`（設定特定事件觸發動作的檔案）執行 `agy plugin validate` 時，也會跑完所有檢查並回報真正的語法錯誤與行號，不再怪罪到 BOM 頭上。
body.en: Files saved with a UTF-8 BOM (a hidden leading marker that indicates encoding) were previously often mishandled. Three such cases are now fixed: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is properly applied on the first run, and `agy acp` loads your settings and authentication options normally instead of falling back to defaults. When running `agy plugin validate` on such a `hooks.json` (the file that configures actions triggered by specific events), it also runs all checks and reports the real syntax error and line number instead of blaming the BOM.

items.original: Fixed more cases of files saved with a UTF-8 byte order mark (BOM) being mishandled: `"modelProvider"` in `settings.json` is now honored on the first run, `agy acp` now loads your settings and authentication options instead of falling back to defaults, and `agy plugin validate` now runs all of its checks on such a `hooks.json` and reports the real syntax error and line instead of blaming the BOM.

title.zh-TW: 修復搭配遠端代理接續對話時互動提示誤開新串的問題
title.en: Fix interactive prompts starting a new thread when resuming with a remote agent

body.zh-TW: 想在遠端代理接續舊對話並馬上送出一句互動提示時，原本的指令組合卻沒把話接回同一串。過去將 `-i`（或 `--prompt-interactive`）搭配 `--remote-agent` 與 `--conversation` 或 `--continue` 使用時，提示詞會誤開成新對話；現在工具會等歷史紀錄載入完成後，再將提示詞送進該段接續的對話。這段提示詞會比照手動輸入的方式處理，因此會立刻顯示在畫面上、排在進行中的回合之後等待，並在傳送失敗時回報錯誤。
body.en: When you wanted to resume an old conversation with a remote agent and send an interactive prompt right away, the command combination previously failed to attach it to the same thread. Using `-i` (or `--prompt-interactive`) together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue` previously started a new conversation by mistake; now the tool waits for the history to finish loading before sending the prompt into that resumed conversation. The prompt is handled like typed input, so it appears on screen right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports an error if sending fails.

items.original: Fixed `-i`/`--prompt-interactive` together with `--remote-agent` and `--conversation` or `--continue`: the prompt is now sent to the resumed conversation after its history loads, instead of starting a new conversation, and it is handled like typed input, so it shows right away, waits behind a running turn, and reports a failed send.

title.zh-TW: 修復 Windows 平台指令引號、SSH 剪貼簿與排程提示問題
title.en: Fix Windows Command Quotes, SSH Clipboard, and Scheduled Prompt Issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上跑自動化、遠端連線複製內容或執行指令時，這三個容易卡關的毛病已經修好。

使用 `!` 執行指令時，PowerShell 不再吃掉雙引號，像 `! git commit -m "two words"` 會照原樣執行；離開 CLI 或在任務面板終止工作時，連帶啟動的程式也會一併結束，不會繼續留在背景執行，工作也不會繼續被標示為執行中。

透過 SSH 遠端連線使用 `/copy` 或其他剪貼簿功能時，複製的內容現在能順利送到你的本機剪貼簿，且不會再被寫進 CLI 的紀錄檔。

Windows 的排程自動化任務不再只讀到多行提示詞的第一行，現在無論是定時排程還是手動觸發執行，都會收到完整的多行提示詞。
body.en:
Three issues that used to trip up running automations, copying over remote connections, or executing commands on Windows are now fixed.

When running commands with `!`, PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed. Quitting the CLI or killing a task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs it started, so they no longer keep running in the background or leave the task marked as running.

When using `/copy` or other clipboard actions over SSH, the copied content now reaches your local clipboard and is no longer written to the CLI log file.

Scheduled automations on Windows no longer read only the first line of a multi-line prompt; both scheduled runs and manually triggered runs now receive the full multi-line prompt.

items.original:
Fixed `!` shell commands on Windows: PowerShell no longer drops double quotes, so commands like `! git commit -m "two words"` run exactly as typed, and quitting the CLI or killing the task in the tasks panel now also ends the programs the command started instead of leaving them running and the task marked as running.
Fixed `/copy` and other clipboard actions on Windows over SSH: the copy now reaches your local clipboard, and the copied text is no longer written to the CLI log file.
Fixed scheduled automations on Windows receiving only the first line of a multi-line prompt; each scheduled or manually triggered run now gets the full prompt.

title.zh-TW: 修正 macOS 反覆彈出鑰匙圈找不到提示框的問題
title.en: Fix Recurring "Keychain Not Found" Dialog on macOS

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 上使用工具時，過去「Keychain Not Found」視窗大約每小時就會重新跳出一次。現在當鑰匙圈寫入失敗後，CLI 會在該工作階段的剩餘期間改把登入 token（用來驗證身分的授權令牌）存進檔案式儲存空間，不再於每次更新 token 時重複嘗試寫入鑰匙圈。
body.en: When using the tool on macOS, the "Keychain Not Found" dialog used to reappear about once an hour. Now, after a keychain write fails, the CLI saves your sign-in token (an authentication credential used to verify your identity) to file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.

items.original: Fixed the macOS "Keychain Not Found" dialog reappearing about once an hour: after a keychain write fails, the CLI now saves your sign-in token to its file-based storage for the rest of the session instead of retrying the keychain on every token refresh.

title.zh-TW: 修復 MCP 伺服器與外掛的啟動競爭及登入異常
title.en: Fix MCP Server and Plugin Startup Race and Sign-In Issues

body.zh-TW:
啟用多個外掛或外部工具並進行帳號驗證時，以下三項連線與登入問題已獲修復。

在多個子代理剛啟動之際重新載入 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，過去會因競爭狀態啟動重複的伺服器程序，導致部分子代理的 MCP 工具失效或登入失敗，現在已解決。

在沒有 IPv4 本機迴環位址的機器上進行 MCP 伺服器與外掛的 OAuth 登入時（例如僅支援 IPv6 的虛擬機），過去在 `127.0.0.1` 無法使用時會無聲失敗，現在登入回呼會改用 `[::1]` 作為備援。

從 `/plugin` 登入外掛時，即使登入剛完成，偶爾會錯誤回報登入尚未完成的問題也已修好。
body.en:
Three connection and sign-in issues when enabling multiple plugins or external tools and authenticating accounts are now fixed.

Reloading MCP (the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers while multiple subagents were starting up used to launch duplicate server processes due to a race condition, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins. That issue is now resolved.

When performing OAuth sign-in for MCP servers and plugins on machines without an IPv4 loopback address (such as IPv6-only VMs), sign-in used to fail silently when `127.0.0.1` was unavailable; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` instead.

Signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` also no longer occasionally reports that sign-in has not finished when it has just succeeded.

items.original:
Fixed a race where reloading MCP servers while several subagents were starting could launch duplicate MCP server processes, leaving some subagents with broken MCP tools or failed sign-ins.
Fixed MCP server and plugin OAuth sign-in on machines without an IPv4 loopback address, such as IPv6-only VMs; the sign-in callback now falls back to `[::1]` when `127.0.0.1` is unavailable instead of failing silently.
Fixed signing in to a plugin from `/plugin` sometimes reporting that the sign-in didn't finish when it had just succeeded.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Ctrl+O 展開工具群組的排版與摘要顯示
title.en: Fix Layout and Summary Display When Expanding Tool Groups with Ctrl+O

body.zh-TW: 當你按 `Ctrl+O` 展開工具群組想看細節時，過去群組位置會跟著跳動。現在收合提示會與展開提示維持在同一行，而在低詳細度模式下，token（計費用的文字單位）摘要列也不會再從展開後的畫面消失。
body.en: When you press `Ctrl+O` to expand a tool group for details, the group position used to jump around. Now the collapse hint stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low-verbosity mode the token (the text unit used for billing) summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.

items.original: Fixed tool groups jumping around when expanded with `Ctrl+O`: the collapse hint now stays on the same line as the expand hint, and in low verbosity the token summary line no longer disappears from the expanded view.

title.zh-TW: 修正手機版遠端控制網頁的模型選單捲動故障
title.en: Fix Model Selector Scrolling in the Mobile Remote Control Web View

body.zh-TW: 拿手機開啟遠端控制網頁想換模型時，過去手指滑動清單卻過不了第一屏，後面的選項怎麼樣都點不到。這個問題已經修好，現在可以觸控捲動超過第一屏，選取清單後段的模型。
body.en: When opening the Remote Control web view on a phone to switch models, swiping the list used to stop at the first screen, making options further down unreachable. This is now fixed, so you can touch-scroll past the first screen and select models near the end of the list.

items.original: Fixed the model selector in the Remote Control browser view on phones, where the list could not be scrolled by touch past the first screen, so models near the end of the list could not be selected.

title.zh-TW: 未識別終端機也能用 Shift+Enter 換行
title.en: Shift+Enter can now insert newlines in unidentified terminals

body.zh-TW:
在終端機撰寫多行提示詞時，輸入過程往往習慣按住 Shift 鍵加上 Enter 換行。如果目前使用的終端機未被工具自動識別，以前按這組按鍵常常無法順利插入換行。

⟦跟飯店櫃檯調整接待方式一樣，以前門僮沒看見熟悉的護照封面就只會講單句英文，現在改好接待安排，遇到陌生封面也能流暢長談。⟧

現在只要在設定檔的 `[ui]` 區塊加入以下設定：

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

將選項設為 `query` 之後，即便終端機屬於未識別型號，按 Shift+Enter 也能正常插入換行字元。
body.en:
When writing multi-line prompts in a terminal, people often press and hold Shift along with Enter to insert newlines. If the current terminal is not automatically recognized by the tool, pressing this key combination previously often failed to insert newlines smoothly.

⟦A hotel front desk adjusts its reception workflow: previously, if the doorman did not see a familiar passport cover, they would speak only in single English sentences, but after updating the arrangements, they can converse smoothly at length even with unfamiliar covers.⟧

Now, you only need to add the following setting under the `[ui]` section of your configuration file:

```toml
[ui]
kitty_keyboard = "query"
```

After setting the option to `query`, pressing Shift+Enter inserts newline characters normally, even if the terminal is an unidentified model.

items.original: `[ui] kitty_keyboard = "query"` lets Shift+Enter insert newlines in unidentified terminals

title.zh-TW: MCP 伺服器連線不再於工作階段重新載入或更新時無故重啟
title.en: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

body.zh-TW:
藉由 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充能力時，你可能會在同一個工作階段中連續處理多項工作。以前在工作階段重新載入或更新時，伺服器連線會跟著無故重啟。

⟦彷彿與外聘顧問保持電話會議，以前每當你更換手邊的討論議程，通話都會無故斷線重撥；現在換議程時，不會再無故斷線重撥。⟧

連線機制調整後，工作階段在重新載入或更新時，不會再莫名重啟既有的伺服器連線。
body.en:
When expanding capabilities through MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), you might handle multiple tasks consecutively within the same session. Previously, server connections would restart unnecessarily whenever a session was reloaded or updated.

⟦Much like keeping an ongoing conference call with an external consultant, previously whenever you switched the discussion agenda at hand, the call would hang up and redial without cause; now when switching agendas, it will no longer disconnect and redial unnecessarily.⟧

Following adjustments to the connection mechanism, existing server connections no longer restart unnecessarily when a session is reloaded or updated.

items.original: MCP server connections no longer restart unnecessarily on session reloads or updates

title.zh-TW: 修正介面多處互動細節，複製與畫面狀態更一致
title.en: Multiple interface interaction details fixed, making copying and screen states more consistent

body.zh-TW:
日常在終端機操作與翻閱紀錄時，游標點擊與畫面資訊的同步表現直接影響使用手感。

引述複製功能現在會完整保留連結中的 `&` 符號；在未選中文字的空白處連按兩下，也不會再誤將思考區塊折疊起來。

快捷鍵 `Ctrl+L` 現在可在更多畫面上使用，且畫面上的複製提示文字，也與實際複製到剪貼簿的內容保持相符。

在執行倒轉操作後，頁尾顯示的上下文用量不再會降為零或顯示過期數值。

在 `/resume` 清單中查看歷史項目時，每一列內容的展開與折疊方式，現在與工作階段內部完全一致。

以前在倒轉後容易看見用量數值失準，或複製連結時遺失特定符號，現在這些介面問題都已經修好。
body.en:
During everyday terminal operations and when browsing history, cursor clicks and the synchronization of screen information directly affect the overall feel.

Quote copy now fully preserves the `&` symbol in links, and double-clicking on empty space with no text selected no longer mistakenly folds thoughts.

The `Ctrl+L` shortcut now works on more screens, and copy hints on screen match what actually copies to the clipboard.

After performing a rewind, context usage shown in the footer no longer drops to zero or displays stale values.

When viewing history items in the `/resume` list, the way each row expands and collapses is now completely consistent with how it behaves inside a session.

Previously, usage values could easily become inaccurate after a rewind, or specific symbols could be lost when copying links; these interface issues have now all been fixed.

title.en: Goal and verify reminders no longer save per-check log files by default to conserve space

Sessions take less disk space: the verify reminder no longer saves a separate log file for each check. To keep those logs, set `plugins.verify-reminder.child_session_log` to `"retained"` in `settings.json`

title.zh-TW: 不看圖的模型遇圖片改註明未附上而不中斷工作階段
title.en: Models that cannot view images now note the image was not attached instead of breaking the session

body.zh-TW: 你正在用純文字模型整理專案檔案，途中它不小心讀進一張螢幕截圖，或外部工具回傳了一張圖片。過去只要遇到無法看圖的模型，無論是讀取圖片檔還是從 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具收到圖片，整個工作階段都會當場中斷。現在這兩種情況不會再弄斷工作階段，執行結果會改為寫明圖片未附上。⟦想像你把彩色海報遞給只讀文字稿的朗讀員，以前他一看到圖畫就當場停擺，現在他只會平靜告知海報沒夾進來，接著照樣把文字讀完。⟧
body.en: Suppose you are organizing project files with a text-only model, and it accidentally reads a screenshot or an external tool returns an image. Previously, on any model that could not view images, reading an image file or receiving an image from an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool would break the entire session on the spot. Now neither case breaks the session, and the result states that the image was not attached instead. ⟦Imagine handing a color poster to a reader who only reads text scripts; he used to stop cold at the sight of a picture, whereas now he calmly notes that the poster was not included and keeps reading the text.⟧

items.original: Reading an image file or getting an image from an MCP tool no longer breaks the session on a model that cannot view images; the result says the image was not attached

title.zh-TW: 編輯器裡的代理程式工作階段無法再儲存時會跳出警告
title.en: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

body.zh-TW: 專心在編輯視窗裡接力推進任務時，你怎麼確定對話進度都還存得下來？⟦恰似拿著拍立得相機不斷按下快門，以前底片匣再也裝不下新照片卻毫無聲響，現在只要畫面存不進去，觀景窗當場就會亮出警訊。⟧當編輯器裡的代理程式（Agent，能自主執行多步驟任務的 AI 助手）工作階段變得無法再儲存時，畫面上現在會直接發出警告。在你接著下達更多指令或準備離開編輯器前，這個提示會直接通知你工作階段已經無法繼續存檔。
body.en: When you are focused on pushing a task forward step by step in an editor window, how can you be sure your conversation progress is still being saved? ⟦Think of snapping away with an instant camera whose film pack can no longer hold another shot without making a sound, whereas now the viewfinder lights up with a warning the moment a frame cannot be saved.⟧ When an Agent (an AI assistant that can autonomously perform multi-step tasks) session in an editor can no longer be saved, a warning now appears on screen. Before you issue more commands or leave the editor, this prompt alerts you directly that the session can no longer be saved.

items.original: Agent sessions in editors warn when the session can no longer be saved

title.zh-TW: `muse exec --json --image` 現在也會為圖片標註編號
title.en: `muse exec --json --image` now labels images with numbers too

body.zh-TW: 當你從終端機執行指令並同時傳入多張圖片給 Muse 時，有時會順手加上 `--json`（一種方便程式讀取的資料格式）參數來接收結果。原本不帶 `--json` 的 `muse exec --image` 指令，就已經會在提示詞裡替每張附加圖片標上 `[Image #N]`。現在只要執行 `muse exec --json --image`，提示詞一樣會為每張附加圖片加上 `[Image #N]` 標籤。比方說你一次附上兩張畫面截圖要它處理，加上 `--json` 後提示詞內依然會出現對應的圖片編號。⟦如同醫生把多張 X 光片放上燈箱時會在角落標出第一張與第二張，以前改用資料格式送圖會少了這層記號，現在每張圖照樣貼上序號方便指認。⟧
body.en: When you run a command from the terminal and pass multiple images to Muse at once, you may also add the `--json` (a data format designed for programs to read) flag to receive the output. Running `muse exec --image` without `--json` already labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt. Now, whenever you run `muse exec --json --image`, the prompt adds the `[Image #N]` label to each attached image as well. For example, if you attach two screenshots at once for processing, the corresponding image numbers still appear in the prompt even with `--json`. ⟦Like a doctor placing multiple X-rays on a lightbox and marking the first and second in the corner, sending images in that data format used to leave off those markings, whereas now each image gets its sequence number for easy reference.⟧

items.original: `muse exec --json --image` now labels each attached image `[Image #N]` in the prompt, as `muse exec --image` without `--json` already does

title.zh-TW: 第一句話很短時，非英語回覆不再被丟棄重寫
title.en: Non-English answers are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short

body.zh-TW: 用自己習慣的母語跟工具打招呼時，開場只寫短短幾個字再自然不過。⟦試想多語導遊帶團時，以前團員只簡短問一句就被誤認成英文團而打掉重講，現在除非你說出常用英語或要求講英文，導遊都會留住原本語言。⟧現在即使你的第一則訊息很簡短，法文、西班牙文、德文以及其他非英語語言的回答，都不會再被丟棄並重新改寫。Muse 只有在你的訊息使用常見英文單字，或你明確要求使用英文時，才會將工作階段語言設為英文。下次開新對話只先傳一句簡短的法文或西班牙文問候時，產出的回答會完整留下，不會突然被整段撤回重寫。
body.en: When greeting a tool in your own native language, starting with just a few words is completely natural. ⟦Picture a multilingual tour guide leading a group: a guest who asked only a brief question used to be mistaken for an English tour and made to start over, whereas now the guide keeps the original language unless you use common English words or ask for English.⟧ Now, even when your first message is short, answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten. Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you explicitly ask for English. The next time you start a new conversation with just a brief French or Spanish greeting, the generated answer will stay intact instead of being suddenly retracted and rewritten.

items.original: Answers in French, Spanish, German, and other non-English languages are no longer discarded and rewritten when your first message is short; Muse sets English as the session language only when your messages use common English words or you ask for English

title.zh-TW: 工作階段完成壓縮後，不再於背景重讀整份紀錄
title.en: Compacted sessions no longer re-read the whole log in the background

body.zh-TW: 在同一個長對話裡連續推敲好一陣子，工具通常會先幫你把冗長內容精簡收斂。過去工作階段經歷壓縮（將長對話精簡濃縮以騰出空間）之後，工具還會在背景把整份工作階段紀錄重新讀過一遍。現在經過壓縮的工作階段，在壓縮完成後不再於背景重讀整份紀錄檔。⟦宛如搬新家前已經把厚重舊雜誌精簡成一疊重點剪報，以前搬完家還要把整箱舊刊物再翻閱一遍，現在打包完就專心用這疊剪報，不再回頭翻舊箱子。⟧
body.en: After working back and forth in the same long conversation for a while, the tool usually condenses the lengthy content for you first. Previously, after a session went through compaction (condensing a long conversation to free up space), the tool would still re-read the entire session log in the background. Now, a compacted session no longer re-reads its whole log file in the background after compaction finishes. ⟦Just as someone moving to a new home trims thick old magazines down to a stack of key clippings, they used to flip through the whole box of old issues again after unpacking, whereas now they stick to those clippings once packed and stop digging back into the old box.⟧

items.original: A session that has compacted no longer re-reads its whole session log in the background after a compaction

entries: **The Codex card shows 100% used once Codex refuses a request for hitting its limit.** Current Codex CLI no longer logs quota after a refused run, so the card kept the last reading, such as 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning. A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

**The Set Up Status Line button now also sets up the Antigravity and Grok status lines.** The button only set up Claude Code; the Antigravity and Grok CLI status lines were added on the next app launch or by turning the status line switch off and on. They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

title.zh-TW: Codex 因額度用完被拒時，卡片改顯示 100% 已用
title.en: Codex Card Shows 100% Used When Refused for Hitting the Limit

body.zh-TW: 請求剛被 Codex 擋下時，讀數往往還停在幾小時前的 99%，旁邊掛著「約 N 小時前更新」的警告。現在的 Codex CLI（在終端機打指令操作的工具）被拒後不再記錄額度，卡片才會一直留著舊讀數。現在只要有比這筆讀數更新的拒絕紀錄，被拒的窗口就會顯示 100% 已用，重置時間照舊，資料新舊從被拒那一刻算起。等那個窗口重置後，卡片會回到正常讀數，不會把 100% 移到另一個窗口。就算有其他工作階段（指單次對話或執行紀錄）比較晚修改，依然找得到另一個工作階段裡的拒絕紀錄。⟦如同停車場入口的車位燈牌，以前柵欄都放不進車卻還亮著「剩一位」，現在只要被柵欄擋過一次，該時段就立刻改掛「已滿」，等時段重置再恢復，不連累另一區。⟧
body.en: Right after Codex blocks a request, the reading often stays stuck at 99% from hours earlier, with an "about N hours ago" warning next to it. Current Codex CLI (a tool you run by typing commands in a terminal) no longer logs quota after a refused run, which is why the card kept showing the old reading. Now, as long as there is a refusal record newer than that reading, the refused window shows 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the moment of the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. Even if another session (a single conversation or run record) was modified more recently, a refusal record in a different session can still be found. ⟦Picture a parking garage entrance sign that used to keep showing "1 spot left" even when the gate could no longer let cars in; now, once the gate blocks a car, that time slot immediately flips to "Full" and returns to normal when the slot resets, without affecting the other zone.⟧

A refusal newer than that reading now marks the refused window as 100% used, keeps its reset time, and counts the data's age from the refusal. Once that window resets, the card goes back to the normal reading instead of moving the 100% to the other window. A refusal in another session is found even when a different session was modified more recently.

title.zh-TW: 「設定狀態列」按鈕現在也會設定 Antigravity 與 Grok
title.en: The "Set Up Status Line" Button Now Also Sets Up Antigravity and Grok

body.zh-TW: 以前想在 Antigravity 與 Grok 啟用 status line（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列），總要等下次開啟應用程式，或是把狀態列開關關掉再打開才會裝上。⟦就像替客廳與書房的新冷氣配對遙控器，以前按下設定鍵只連上第一台，另外兩台得重開電源才抓得到訊號；現在只要機器裝在牆上，按一次就通通配好。⟧這顆「設定狀態列」按鈕原本只設定 Claude Code，不會處理這兩個 CLI（在終端機打指令操作的工具）。現在只要裝了這兩個 CLI，按下按鈕就會馬上設定好，macOS 與 Windows 都一樣。
body.en: Previously, enabling a status line (the bar shown at the very bottom of the terminal) in Antigravity and Grok required waiting until the next app launch or turning the status line switch off and back on before it would be installed. ⟦Like pairing a remote with new air conditioners in the living room and study, pressing the setup button used to connect only the first unit while the other two had to be power-cycled to pick up the signal; now, as long as the units are mounted on the wall, one press pairs them all.⟧ This "Set Up Status Line" button originally only configured Claude Code and did not handle these two CLIs (tools you run by typing commands in a terminal). Now, as long as those two CLIs are installed, pressing the button sets them up right away, on both macOS and Windows.

They are now set up right away when those CLIs are installed, on macOS and Windows.

## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: gh repo delete 刪除私人或內部儲存庫會要求額外確認 fork
title.en: gh repo delete requires extra fork confirmation when deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理團隊舊專案時，你可能會在終端機敲指令把整個儲存庫（集中存放專案檔案與修改紀錄的空間）刪掉。⟦就像拆掉營地的主帳篷一樣，以前交出免確認單就直接拆走，現在只要旁邊還連著隊友的小帳篷，管理員就會先喊停再問一次，連無人拆除車都得先拿到連帶拆除授權才動工。⟧

當你用 `gh repo delete` 刪除私人或內部儲存庫，而且會連帶刪掉底下的 fork（從原專案複製出的獨立複本）時，工具會跳出警告。就算指令已經附上 `--yes`（略過一般詢問的參數），你還是得完成這項額外確認。

如果是靠排程腳本這類非互動式工作流程（無法等待人工輸入的執行環境），或交給替你自動跑指令的代理程式來刪，就必須在指令裡明確同意連帶刪除：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```
body.en:
When cleaning up old team projects, you might run a command in your terminal to delete an entire repository (a central space storing project files and change history). ⟦Picture tearing down a campsite's main tent: previously, handing in a no-confirmation slip meant taking it straight down, whereas now, as long as teammates' smaller tents are still attached beside it, the manager stops and asks again, and even an unmanned demolition rig must get cascading-demolition authorization before starting work.⟧

When you use `gh repo delete` to delete a private or internal repository and it will also delete the forks (independent copies branched from the original project) beneath it, the tool shows a warning. Even if the command already includes `--yes` (the flag that skips standard prompts), you still have to complete this extra confirmation.

If the deletion is handled by a non-interactive workflow (an execution environment that cannot wait for human input) such as a scheduled script, or by an agent that automatically runs commands for you, you must explicitly accept the cascading deletion in the command:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```
